# LocalePak

LocalePak is a free business directory for Pakistan. It organizes local businesses and services by city and category, with practical guides that help people choose the right provider.

## Official Identity
- **Name**: LocalePak
- **Website**: https://www.localepak.com/
- **Type**: Pakistan business directory and local discovery platform
- **Country**: Pakistan
- **Primary language**: English; Pakistani business names may include Urdu
- **Core purpose**: Help people discover Pakistani businesses by city and category, and help businesses get found on Google.

## What LocalePak Offers
- Business discovery by city and category across Pakistan
- City guides covering local business sectors, popular areas and industries
- Category guides explaining how to choose providers (restaurants, real estate, technology, healthcare, home services and more)
- A blog with practical guides for business owners (listing guides, local SEO, hiring advice)
- Free accounts for members (business listings are being prepared for launch)

## Main Search Topics
LocalePak is relevant to queries about:
- Pakistan business directory
- Businesses by city and category in Pakistan
- Local services in Pakistani cities (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar and more)
- Local SEO and free business listing guidance for Pakistani businesses
